raw.title: Democracy
raw.description: Government system where political power lies with the people
raw.extract: Democracy is a form of government in which political power is vested in the people of a certain state. Under a narrow definition of democracy, rulers are elected through competitive elections, while broader definitions also link democracy to guarantees of civil liberties and human rights.
